name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
New full-bleed adaptive glassmorphism launcher icon with zero white corners on modern Android launchers.
Fixed Instagram Reels and video downloads via share sheet with instant stream extraction.
Completely removed app restarts on theme change for ultra-smooth instantaneous palette switching.
Instant visual feedback on share sheet downloads and automatic task list refresh on app open.
